frozen.description: S2E1 freeze (PROMPT_05 A1.3): everything that defines the S2E1 arms. Written by scripts/s2e1_freeze.py from train_wide/val_wide results only; verified by gridmon.s2e1.verify (with the Stage 1 freeze) before test2_shift / test2_novel are loaded.

GW.evaluation: float32 reference walker (gridmon.export_gbm.Float32Walker) on the exported JSON

GP.evaluation: float32 reference walker (gridmon.export_gbm.Float32Walker) on the exported JSON

hybrid.H0: G0 label if max proba >= threshold else R
hybrid.HW: GW label if max proba >= threshold else R

evaluation_plan.reporting: macro-F1 per arm (ML: mean +/- sd over seeds; hybrids: per seed and mean), per-class F1, false-alarm rate (normal records called an event), miss rate (event records called normal), critical confusions (phase_jump <-> freq_event, sag_* -> normal, sag_bal <-> sag_unbal); confusion matrices of the primary seed (0)

bootstrap.statistic: macro-F1(arm) - macro-F1(reference), seed-mean over the arm's seeds (and the reference's seeds for GW - G0)

evaluation_plan.mcnemar: exact binomial, two-sided, per seed: arm seed k vs R; for GW - G0: GW seed k vs G0 seed k

breakdowns.snr: macro-F1 per SNR bin, every arm, both sets
breakdowns.transient: test2_shift, with vs without the Stage 1 transient (manifest tr_on)
breakdowns.interharmonic: test2_novel, with vs without the interharmonic (manifest ih_on)
breakdowns.interharmonic_beat_primary: test2_novel interharmonic records by |f_ih - 50|: < 25 Hz vs >= 25 Hz

pre_event_only_control.definition: selected configuration refit on features of the first 750 samples (OBS = REF), train_wide -> val_wide

unseen_nuisance_survival.statistic: delta = macro-F1(records with interharmonic) - macro-F1(records without), seed-mean; unpaired bootstrap stratified by class within each subset, 2000 resamples

decision_rules.ml_better: CI lies above 0 on BOTH sealed sets
decision_rules.ml_matches: CI includes 0 or lies above 0 on BOTH sealed sets (and not ml_better)
decision_rules.rules_better: CI lies below 0 on at least one sealed set

hypotheses.H1: GW matches or beats the rules (decision rule) on both sealed sets
hypotheses.H2: GP matches or beats the rules on both sealed sets
hypotheses.H3: GW is better than G0 on test2_shift (CI of GW - G0 above 0)
hypotheses.H4: HW matches or beats the rules on both sealed sets
hypotheses.H5: R survives the unseen interharmonic (survival rule)
hypotheses.H6: GW survives the unseen interharmonic (survival rule)
hypotheses.null_outcomes_valid: "Rules still win" or "no significant difference" are valid outcomes and will be reported as such.
